ARE.note: Ministry of Cabinet Affairs is the only GFF; no forward-looking product in its own name was found in the window, and the prime minister has not changed since its 2016 foresight mandate.

BRA.note: Ipea's statute names prospective studies (Decree 7.142/2010, reissued 2022), which carries I3 across the 2011 change of president; Seplan carries I2 with the Brasil 2050 megatrends report, credited to Seplan by the ministry's 2025 management report.

CHE.note: The Federal Chancellery carries all three items; its foresight mandate dates from RVOG art. 32 cter (in force 2015) and survives the collegial-council majority change of 31 Dec 2018.

EST.note: The Foresight Centre carries all three items; the Development Fund's foresight duties ended on 29 June 2016, before the I4 window.

GBR.note: POST carries I1 through the Commons resolution of 21 Nov 2000; GO-Science carries I2 and I3; the closed Horizon Scanning Programme team has a named same-branch successor.

NGA.note: OSPRE (Executive Order 12, 10 June 2022) is read as a GFF on its own page's long-term horizon-scanning mandate and survives the 2023 change of president; no dated product in its own name could be read.

NIC.note: No body meets section 1: the SPING Council's own tasks name no foresight term, and the plan's 'planificación estratégica-prospectiva' attaches to the system.

SGP.note: The Centre for Strategic Futures carries all three items; the Scenario/Strategic Policy Office ended by July 2015 with CSF as successor.

VNM.note: No body meets section 1: candidate mandates use 'dự báo' (forecast).
